Noah: CI red on nightly h100 smoke (shard 7). Seeing a couple of different failures in the same run: an undefined symbol from libcuda followed by an OOM during warmup. anyone else seeing this?
Liz: @Noah can you paste the last 10 lines of the container log?
Noah: sure, pasted below:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:01Z] ERROR: /usr/local/lib/libcuda.so.1: undefined symbol: cuGetExportTable
[2026-03-17T02:14:02Z] WARN: falling back to local kernel registry
[2026-03-17T02:14:05Z] INFO: starting model warmup
[2026-03-17T02:14:06Z] ERROR: Allocation failed: CUDA out of memory when allocating 2048 MiB
[2026-03-17T02:14:06Z] ERROR: aborting warmup, exiting
```
gpu-ci-bot: Build 3821 matrix(h100) failed: smoke_h100_warmup shard 7. Rerun available: `/ci/rerun 3821`
Raj: @Noah can you try reproducing locally with the canary image? `IMAGE=nightly-canary-3821 ./run-smoke.sh --device h100`
Noah: tried that — it reproduces intermittently. sometimes the run fails with the undefined symbol, other times it gets to warmup and OOMs.
Sarah: this reads like a driver / lib mismatch + memory fragmentation. do we know which driver version is on those nodes? last known-good was 535.86 according to release notes.
Chen: Also check MIG / device assignment. add `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` to the repro steps so we capture module info.
Liz: I'll kick off 3 reruns on different hosts and attach pstack/dmesg if they fail. tagging eng-sre.
Noah: thanks — if it keeps failing can someone start a bisect between base images from 2026-03-01..2026-03-10? I suspect a driver swap landed in that window.
Raj: I can run the bisect but need a minimal repro script and the exact command we use on CI. @Noah can you share `smoke-repro.sh`? Also include `modinfo nvidia` output.
Noah: uploaded gist with the small repro and run steps: https://gist.github.com/placeholder/smoke-repro.sh
gpu-ci-bot: Rerun queued: build 3821 x3 on hosts h100-03, h100-05, h100-09 (expected finish ~+12m)
Liz: if it OOMs again, set `DEBUG_ALLOC=1` in the env to get allocator traces and full heap map.
Noah: good idea, will add that and re-run locally. Also adding `LD_DEBUG=all` just for the symbol lookup trace.
Sree: saw a spike like this during last driver's canary rollout. if we cross >5% failure I will pause that rollout and notify infra.
Mike: I'll audit the node images and try launching a canary with the older pinned driver (535.86) to compare.
Noah: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post logs from the three reruns here once they finish. :thumbsup:
Liz: pinging eng-infra and eng-sre in case this needs faster rollback @Sree @Mike :eyes:
Noah: update 20m: first rerun failed with the same symbol error, second got to warmup and OOMed, third passed. collecting outputs now.
